title: A Kerala port just became one of the fastest in the world to hit 1,000 ships
sources: Business Today - Vizhinjam welcomes 1000th vessel, joins world's fastest-growing ports club
The Week - Vizhinjam port 1000 vessel milestone
caption:
A Kerala port just became one of the fastest in the world to hit 1,000 ships. In under two years.

Vizhinjam International Seaport received its 1,000th commercial vessel in June 2026 - less than two years after its first commercial call. By May 2026 it had already handled 2 million containers and 67 ultra-large vessels, both Indian port records. A Phase II expansion targeting 57 lakh TEU annual capacity is already underway.

Most ports take a decade to build this kind of traffic. Vizhinjam did it before its second birthday.
